tx.label: You have {{tx_cnt}} transaction(s) to confirm
tx.caption: Click to expand each transaction to reveal more details
tx.hw: Confirm transaction {{txindex}} of {{txtotal}} on your {{device}} device
tx.keystonehash: Due to size, only the transaction body hash can be shown on the device!
tx.review: Please review the transaction before confirming

cu.headline: $t(send-options:cu.label)
cu.caption: Collect UTxOs for this account by merging them into fewer ones.

send-all.headline: Sending all funds
send-all.caption: This transaction sends all the funds in your account. Please verify the details for the destination address.

high-fee.headline: Higher than normal fee
high-fee.caption: A higher than normal transaction fee was detected. Please verify the transaction details to ensure this is what you want.

withdraw.headline: Withdraw rewards
withdraw.caption: Your rewards are automatically part of your delegated stake. There's no need to withdraw rewards unless you're sending them elsewhere or need them to count towards catalyst voting power.

pool-deleg.headline: Pool delegation
pool-deleg.caption: A stake pool delegation transaction. View the transaction for details.

vote-deleg.headline: Vote delegation
vote-deleg.caption: A governance vote delegation transaction. View the transaction for details.

ms-reg.headline: Multi-Sig wallet registration
ms-reg.caption: This registers the Multi-Sig wallet on the blockchain for easy discovery by all participants.

cat-reg.headline: Catalyst registration
cat-reg.caption: This creates a Catalyst vote registration transaction. This registration is valid for upcoming Catalyst fund snapshots unless overridden by a newer registration.

collateral.headline: Collateral UTxO
collateral.caption: Generates collateral UTxOs sometimes needed when interacting with DApps.

swap-order.headline: Swap order
swap-order.caption: A MonsterSwap order transaction providing the best available routes.

swap-cancel.headline: Cancel swap order
swap-cancel.caption: A cancellation transaction for a previously posted swap order.

hwForcedPlutusMode.headline: Forced Plutus mode for hardware wallet compatibility
hwForcedPlutusMode.caption: Due to device restrictions, the request sent to your hardware device is marked as a plutus transaction even though it isn't one. This will give you additional warnings when confirming. Please carefully check that the transaction does what you intend.

hasDatumInputUtxo.headline: Spending UTxO with datum
hasDatumInputUtxo.caption: An input UTxO that contains a datum was found. Please verify that you want to spend this UTxO. Lock it on the UTxO page to prevent it from being selected as an input.

hasRefScriptInputUtxo.headline: Spending UTxO with ref. script
hasRefScriptInputUtxo.caption: An input (or collateral input) UTxO that contains a reference script was found. Please verify that you want to spend this UTxO. Lock it on the UTxO page to prevent it from being selected as an input.

hasUnknownInputs.headline: $t(sign-tx:error.unknownInputs)
hasUnknownInputs.caption: Please manually preview and verify the transaction(s) you sign. This can sometimes be used as a replacement to Sign Data for increased compatibility across hardware devices by signing an invalid transaction that includes metadata to witness.

hasExpiredTx.headline: Transaction has expired
hasExpiredTx.caption: The transactions time to life (TTL) has expired and will be rejected by the network.

error.expired: Unable to submit! Transaction lifetime has expired. Please recreate the transaction with a new expiration date (TTL).
error.auxDataMismatch: There's a mismatch between the attached metadata and the hash requested for signing. The metadata shown for this transaction isn't what you'll be signing!
error.debug: For further support, please open a Discord ticket with the downloaded debug data.
error.unknownInputs: Unable to calculate an accurate transaction balance due to unknown inputs.
error.doubleSpend: Invalid transaction list: Input utxo is spent more than once.
error.missingKeys: Transaction(s) don't need any witnesses from available account(s). If already confirmed, please close and submit.
error.locked: Transaction(s) attempt to spend one or more of your manually locked UTxOs.
error.passwordMismatch: Entered passwords don't match, please try again!

fixPermissionUSB.text: Click the button and follow the instructions to allow the USB connection.

fixPermissionBLE.text: Click the button and follow the instructions to allow the Bluetooth connection.

fixPermissionCamera.text: Click the button and follow the instructions to allow Camera access.

info.signDownload: The transaction has been confirmed by all available accounts.
info.multiSigShare: Share the transaction to notify Multi-Sig wallet participants, or alternatively download and share the transaction manually.

submit.shift: Shift + click -> bypass checks and try to submit

remoteSign.title: Sign on Another Device
remoteSign.description: Select a paired device to send this transaction for signing.
remoteSign.buttonTooltip: Sign on another device via Eternl Hub
remoteSign.noDevices: No paired devices. Enable Eternl Hub and pair a device first.
remoteSign.allOffline: All paired devices are currently offline. Please open Eternl on another device first.
remoteSign.timeout: Signing request timed out - the other device did not respond

error.signingNotAvailable: Signing service not available. Please check your Eternl Hub connection.
